event_state_restore.details: Caches/restores bbox, frame, templates, patch, latest query, selected_feature, initial reference, words/mask/empty and RNG; legal t0 initialization constructs invariant native/model/preprocessor fields. box_mask_z is asserted None. alias_and_permanent_slot.details: Initial duplicate template object is cloned once per snapshot, preserving within-snapshot identity. W replaces slot1, leaves slot0 intact, and copies the companion patch.

current_submission_and_order.details: Caller takes an independent pre-step template list and old patch reference; step replaces the patch and appends/pops template slots. Event snapshots the just-committed frame/bbox/query/feature, undoing only template/patch. It collects first12 actual writes without GT filtering and leaves collection actor on its native-write trajectory.

gt_provenance.details: Only legal first_box initialization is used before prediction. Current/future GT is read after K/K and W/K finish. Dataset GT provides per-frame IoU and mean valid-future W-minus-K IoU; it never selects events or drives crops/query/templates.

unknown_negative_and_normalization.details: GT validity is finite xywh and positive extent. Invalid labels remain null; empty valid future set yields null delta. Negative/zero labels and ineligible events remain in receipts. No metric divides by model prediction statistics; decoder response remains inference logic.

frames_and_tail.details: Internal frame f maps to image stem f+1 and GT[f]. Future indices are f+1 through min(f+32,N-1), within the same case. Events are at multiples of50 and <=32 future frames cannot reach next update. Archived toy07 GT has1406 rows with first row matching spec; existing loader truncates to1367 image frames.

shared_dependencies.details: Mutable query lists and tensors are branch-owned; initial/words are read-only on inspected path. CLIP hook closures are local and removed after sequential normal calls. backbone.keep_rate is overwritten from invariant native keep_rate each forward. Read active project forwards reveal no further cross-frame module history; external frameworks/kernels remain outside scope.

frozen_inputs.details: P1 final constant equals local final byte hash and archived trained result; spec hash equals trained result. Source checks bank/labels human-confirmed depthtrack provenance, trained bank/labels hashes, native checkpoint through spec and CLIP through bank, sequence set and seed2027. Models eval/frozen; no optimizer.

rng_same_device.details: Python,NumPy,Torch CPU and current CUDA RNG are cached; payload RNG is restored after initialization and future-image reading. Each pair restores same entry RNG per sequential branch and on normal return. All event tensors move to current CUDA device; pair checks equal/current device. ordinal%2 splits six events per worker. Actual physical GPU assignment is a later launcher responsibility.

kk_and_raw_evidence.details: K/K executes two independent keep branches and compares each full record/query/selected_feature plus final submission. True receipt is constructed only after successful comparisons. Raw storage includes first K/K trajectory and W/K trajectories, plus event input payload and native prefix. It does not retain second K/K trajectory, so its equality is runtime assertion evidence, not independently recomputable from both stored K/K branches.
